tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, top of the page gradient (bg → bg-end, 180deg, spanning the screen, not the scroll length). Also the detail CTA bar and the ground of contained photos on the detail page. Direction A, 2026-10-14 (was #FFFFFF).

tokens.name: bg-end
tokens.usage: Bottom of the page gradient. All text on the page ground is checked against this darker end: text 13.4:1, text-2 5.6:1, status -text ≥4.5:1, logo 4.8:1. New in direction A.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: White surfaces that float on the gradient: AnimalCard, home choice cards, BottomSheet, FavoriteButton, filter button, Chip, Select, selected Segmented. New in direction A (the role bg used to play).

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: PC only: the strip on both sides of the 480px column. Never inside the column.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Warm dark brown. Titles, card titles, body copy: 13.4:1 on bg-end (the darker end of the page gradient), 15.7:1 on surface. Also the fill of the default primary Button, selected Chip/Segmented and Toast, and the filled favourite heart. (was #111111)

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Warm secondary copy: 5.6:1 on bg-end, 6.6:1 on surface, 6.0:1 on canvas. Card subline, labels, captions. (was #666666)

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Warm hairlines: detail info divider, sheet dividers. Decorative (not a control cue). Cards and buttons no longer use outlines; they use shadows. (was #EEEEEE)

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Outline of Radio and Select, where the border itself marks the control. 3.45:1 on surface; these controls only sit on surface (the bottom sheet), never on the page gradient (2.9:1 on bg-end).

tokens.name: on-text
tokens.usage: Label on text-filled surfaces: default primary Button (e.g. 다시 시도), selected Chip/Segmented, Toast (14.9:1 on text). (was #FFFFFF)

tokens.name: logo
tokens.usage: Home wordmark 냥공고 only (Jua 20px, 4.8:1 on bg-end). Not an accent: never on buttons, icons or other text.

tokens.name: apply-from
tokens.usage: Start of the 적용하기 button gradient (135deg). Only the filter sheet's 적용하기 uses it.

tokens.name: apply-to
tokens.usage: End of the 적용하기 button gradient. Peach, pinker than status-soon so it never reads as 임박.

tokens.name: on-apply
tokens.usage: 적용하기 label: 7.1:1 on apply-to, 11.0:1 on apply-from.

tokens.name: choice-halo
tokens.usage: Centre of the 104px radial halo behind each character on the home choice cards. Decoration only, never behind photos.

tokens.name: choice-halo-end
tokens.usage: Edge of the home choice halo (radial gradient, 72%).

tokens.name: status-protected
tokens.usage: Dot and point colour for 보호중 only. 3.3:1 on bg: always paired with the label, never alone. Not for text.

tokens.name: status-protected-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the 보호중 StatusBadge off photo.

tokens.name: status-protected-text
tokens.usage: Label of 보호중 on status-protected-bg (4.75:1), on the photo pill (5.3:1) and as the big D-day on the detail page (4.53:1 on bg-end).

tokens.name: status-soon
tokens.usage: Dot and point colour for 임박 (D-day within 3 days). 2.5:1 on bg: always paired with the label. Not for text.

tokens.name: status-soon-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the 임박 StatusBadge off photo. Derived tint of status-soon (not in the brief): confirm.

tokens.name: status-soon-text
tokens.usage: Label of 임박 on status-soon-bg (4.72:1), on the photo pill (5.3:1) and as the big D-day (4.51:1 on bg-end). The suggested #B85F0B measured 4.49 on white, so it was darkened.

tokens.name: status-ended
tokens.usage: Dot for 종료 (3.45:1 on bg). Not for text: the label uses status-ended-text.

tokens.name: status-ended-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the 종료 StatusBadge off photo and of SkeletonCard blocks.

tokens.name: status-ended-text
tokens.usage: Label of 종료 on status-ended-bg (4.99:1); 4.9:1 on bg-end. Stays neutral grey on purpose: ended notices are calm.

tokens.name: photo-pill
tokens.usage: Badge background over a photo: white 90% pill. Its label uses the status text token, its dot the status point token.

tokens.name: kakao
tokens.usage: ShareButton background. The single non-status accent in the system.

tokens.name: on-kakao
tokens.usage: ShareButton label and icon on kakao (13.8:1).

tokens.name: viewer-bg
tokens.usage: Full-screen image viewer background.

tokens.name: on-viewer
tokens.usage: Close icon and page indicator (1/5) on viewer-bg.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Label and icon of disabled controls on disabled-bg. Exempt from 4.5:1 (inactive control) at 2.2:1.

tokens.name: disabled-bg
tokens.usage: Background of disabled Button and Chip.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring with 2px offset, 18.9:1 on bg.

families.sans: "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: "Jua", "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Pretendard title for calm or system screens: ended-notice detail title, error, empty and result-less states. Display titles use the Display group.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card and section titles, button labels. Line-height derived.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body, sublines, option labels. Line-height derived.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, helper text, page indicator. Line-height derived.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: StatusBadge label. Caption size with weight 600 so the status reads within 0.5s; not in the brief.

styles.name: display-home
styles.usage: Home question. Jua (OFL, Google Fonts), 400 only: never fake bold.

styles.name: display-detail
styles.usage: Detail title (region) of a protected or soon notice. Ended notices use the Pretendard title style instead.

styles.name: display-title
styles.usage: List screen title and the 고양이 / 강아지 labels on the home choice cards.

styles.name: display-logo
styles.usage: Home wordmark, in the logo colour.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gap, inner padding of pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards (feed rhythm).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Left/right page padding; card text padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gap inside the bottom sheet.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target: icon buttons, chips, radio rows.

tokens.name: frame-w
tokens.usage: Design frame width (iPhone 14). Reference only, never a layout width.

tokens.name: column-max
tokens.usage: Content column max-width, centred on desktop. Fixed elements are positioned inside it, not the viewport.

tokens.name: safe-top
tokens.usage: iPhone 14 status area in frames. In code use env(safe-area-inset-top).

tokens.name: safe-bottom
tokens.usage: iPhone 14 home indicator in frames. In code use env(safe-area-inset-bottom).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: AnimalCard, SkeletonCard, detail photo box, bottom sheet top corners. (was 16px)

tokens.name: radius-choice
tokens.usage: Home choice cards (고양이 / 강아지).

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Select field and Toast. Derived (brief only fixes card and pill).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chip, StatusBadge, Segmented, Button, icon buttons.

motion.note: Motion supports the photo. The list moves once on its first screen and never while scrolling; ended notices never move; reduced-motion switches instantly. Values are the ones MotionA actually played.

tokens.name: press-duration
tokens.usage: Press: AnimalCard, Button, Chip, home choice card scale to press-scale; AnimalCard also drops to shadow-card-pressed. Not on ended cards.

tokens.name: sheet-duration
tokens.usage: BottomSheet slide in and out.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Easing for sheet and toast.

tokens.name: ease-emphasized
tokens.usage: Card → detail photo transition.

tokens.name: ease-heart
tokens.usage: Favourite heart pop, applied to each half (1 → heart-scale, heart-scale → 1).

tokens.name: enter-duration
tokens.usage: Home entrance per element, ease-out, from enter-distance below.

tokens.name: enter-stagger
tokens.usage: Home entrance order: title (with subline) → cat card → dog card → link. Ends at 500ms.

tokens.name: enter-distance
tokens.usage: Home entrance rise.

tokens.name: list-enter-duration
tokens.usage: List first screen, once: only cards on the first screen, ended cards excluded.

tokens.name: list-enter-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between first-screen cards.

tokens.name: list-enter-distance
tokens.usage: List entrance rise.

tokens.name: heart-duration
tokens.usage: Heart fill + pop inside the white circle on the photo (the circle keeps its size).

tokens.name: heart-off-duration
tokens.usage: Heart un-fill fade.

tokens.name: detail-duration
tokens.usage: Card photo grows into the detail photo box, ease-emphasized. Detail ground is opaque from the first frame.

tokens.name: detail-info-delay
tokens.usage: Detail info (badge, title, rows, CTA bar) fades in after this delay.

tokens.name: detail-info-duration
tokens.usage: Detail info fade; also the whole fallback where shared-element transitions are not supported (photo + info fade, ground opaque).

tokens.name: press-scale
tokens.usage: Pressed scale for AnimalCard, Button, Chip and Radio dot. Applied with transform: scale(var(--press-scale)) over press-duration.

tokens.name: heart-scale
tokens.usage: Peak of the heart pop at 45% of heart-duration.

tokens.name: char-press-x
tokens.usage: Character press squash, width (bottom-centre origin, press-duration). No head tilt.

tokens.name: char-press-y
tokens.usage: Character press squash, height.

shadow.note: Warm brown, two layers, on white surfaces only. Never on or over a photo.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: AnimalCard and home choice cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-card-pressed
tokens.usage: AnimalCard while pressed (with press-scale), from MotionA.

tokens.name: shadow-card-ended
tokens.usage: Ended AnimalCard: flat and calm, no press change.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: FavoriteButton (detail CTA bar) and the filter button: white with this shadow, no outline.

tokens.name: shadow-chip
tokens.usage: Unselected Chip. Selected Chip is text-filled with no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-apply
tokens.usage: 적용하기 button only.

tokens.name: shadow-photo
tokens.usage: Around (never on) the detail photo box of a protected or soon notice. Ended detail: no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-bar
tokens.usage: Top edge of the detail CTA bar (replaces the 1px border).
